objective: Reach sustainable INR 100000/month owner-withdrawable cash through lawful customer-funded recurring revenue, with paper-only capital experiments until promotion gates are satisfied.

coordinator.name: Coordinator / CEO Orchestrator
coordinator.responsibility: Select the highest-value unblocked task, coordinate agents, preserve state, and enforce evidence/approval gates.
coordinator.goal_link: Maximize verified progress toward the monthly owner-withdrawable cash target while minimizing cost, risk, duplication, and founder interruption.
coordinator.implementation_evidence: Repository state machine, TODO/CURRENT/STATE files, CI gates, and OpenClaw-facing boot protocol exist; no separately identified runtime task history is yet logged.
allowed_actions: open or merge reversible code changes after validation

sales.name: Sales Agent
sales.responsibility: Process inbound enquiries, qualify and score leads, maintain pipeline state, prepare follow-ups, and surface founder decisions.
sales.goal_link: Increase verified qualified demand and paid-pilot conversion.
sales.implementation_evidence: Public enquiry intake, deterministic scoring, qualification, pipeline, follow-up scheduling, daily brief, audit trail, and constrained automation client are implemented and tested.

quotation.name: Quotation / Proposal Agent
quotation.responsibility: Draft deterministic proposals and artifacts from approved business inputs while preserving founder approval for binding decisions.
quotation.goal_link: Reduce proposal turnaround time without weakening pricing, legal, or approval controls.
quotation.implementation_evidence: Proposal drafts, deterministic artifacts, approval state machine, secure shares, and founder-only approval enforcement are implemented and tested.

support.name: Support / Customer Success Agent
support.responsibility: Handle post-sale support and customer-success workflows once real paid demand creates an evidence-based need.
support.goal_link: Protect retention and reduce founder support load after the first paid pilot.
support.implementation_evidence: No dedicated customer-success workflow is implemented; building it before paid demand would not advance the current evidence bottleneck.

marketing.name: Marketing Agent
marketing.responsibility: Design lawful, source-attributed acquisition experiments and content plans; do not activate broad promotion before the public deployment/privacy gate.
marketing.goal_link: Generate measurable external enquiries at acceptable observed CAC after T100.
marketing.implementation_evidence: Public quote funnel and source-attributed economics model exist, but verified external enquiries are zero and broad promotion is gated until deployment and monitored public contact are ready.

media.name: Media / Content Agent
media.responsibility: Produce reusable draft media assets that support approved acquisition experiments without autonomous publication.
media.goal_link: Increase qualified attention and reduce content-production effort per validated acquisition test.
media.implementation_evidence: No autonomous publisher is enabled by design; current repository has no runtime media-performance observations.

operations.name: Operations / Reliability Agent
operations.responsibility: Maintain deployment readiness, backups, recovery, monitoring, CI, and operational runbooks.
operations.goal_link: Keep the revenue system reliable and recoverable with minimal founder maintenance.
operations.implementation_evidence: Docker/Compose, CI, non-root runtime, persistent-volume handling, backup/restore tooling, Railway runbook, and non-mutating deployment preflight are implemented and validated in sandbox.

finance.name: Finance / Economics Agent
finance.responsibility: Separate simulated from realized economics, reconcile verified payments, and measure contribution economics and cash progress.
finance.goal_link: Prove a sustainable path to INR 100000/month owner-withdrawable cash using observed unit economics.
finance.implementation_evidence: Paper-money model, funnel economics, founder-gated Razorpay adapter, verified payment reconciliation, and revenue summary exist; verified collected cash remains INR 0.

trading_research.name: Trading Research Agent
trading_research.responsibility: Research market-capital strategies only inside the separate paper-validation boundary; it is not the primary money engine.
trading_research.goal_link: Explore optional capital returns without risking the core business or bypassing long paper-validation gates.
trading_research.implementation_evidence: The current Sales OS repository intentionally does not contain live trading execution. Any strategy-factory work remains a separate project boundary and paper-only for promotion decisions.

trading_risk_execution.name: Trading Risk / Execution Agent
trading_risk_execution.responsibility: Apply deterministic risk gates to paper strategies; real execution remains disabled until explicit future promotion criteria and approval are satisfied.
trading_risk_execution.goal_link: Prevent speculative capital experiments from threatening the business mission.
trading_risk_execution.implementation_evidence: No live execution capability is part of the Sales OS repository; real-money actions are explicitly forbidden at the current evidence level.
